description:
The Avare aviation GPS app is open on the main map screen. Your task:
1. Tap the 'Menu' button at the bottom-left of the screen.
2. Tap 'Preferences' from the menu options on the left.
3. In the Preferences categories, tap 'Display'.
4. Scroll down if needed and find 'Night Mode (requires restart)'.
5. Enable the Night Mode checkbox (it should currently be unchecked).
6. Press Back to return to the map screen. The night mode setting should now be enabled (note: visual changes take effect after app restart).
